info.description: Many apps demand your attention, Breathe gives it back. Short cycles of guided breathing that help you relax, focus, or sleep better.

relax.description: Coherent breathing. Activates the parasympathetic system, which brings calm to the body.

focus.description: Box breathing. Equal intervals create balance in the nervous system, bringing calm and focus.

sleep.description: 4-7-8 breathing. Slows the body down, step by step, for a peaceful night.

session.title: What do you need right now?
session.prepare: Breathe out as much as you can.
